title: CDR Review Service Australia | CDR Writers Australia
description: Get your self-written or existing CDR checked by experts, with clear feedback on structure, depth and competency coverage.

data.sub: A second pair of expert eyes on your self-written CDR.

items.title: Structure
items.text: Sections, length and Engineers Australia format.

items.title: Technical depth
items.text: Is your engineering role clear and specific?

items.title: Competency coverage
items.text: Do the episodes support the competency elements?

items.q: Will you rewrite my CDR during a review?
items.a: A review gives written feedback on what to change. If you want the changes made for you, choose CDR Optimization.

items.q: Can you review a CDR that Engineers Australia returned?
items.a: Yes. Send it with the assessor's comments and we will focus on the points raised.
